items.claim: [r56-4] `sliderAt` under `strict` with no stops returned the raw, unclamped track value
[r57-2] `sliderKey` with stops and `ordered` landed a thumb between stops when the next stop was its neighbor's
[r57-4] A sweep's `at` answered `NaN` or `undefined` for a `NaN` fraction
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made. I chose to throw a `RangeError` from every sweep, and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`; treating `NaN` as 0 was the alternative. No non-test caller reads `at`, so nothing that ships now throws because of it.

items.claim: framesSweep runs a whole pass of a run shorter than one, `loop` below 1
items.note: the clock plays any `loop` below 1 as one whole pass (`passesOf` is `Math.max(1, loop)`, `clock/src/place.ts`), so walking a full pass is right. A's suggested fix would have made it wrong. The real defect is B's, below.

items.claim: framesSweep counts passes differently from the clock for `loop` 0, a fraction below 1, or a negative number
rangeSweep treats finite ends whose difference overflows as an endless range
movedIndex reads a gap past the end, or an index outside the list, differently from moveItems
items.note: Both functions now take `length`, and every caller in `ui` and `diagram` passes it.

items.claim: movedIndex and isNoopDrop read a gap past the end differently from moveItems
items.note: duplicate of A's movedIndex finding, fixed in the same commit (4fcfa1f9f6)

items.claim: soloFrom and soloSweepFrom ignore `enabled` in a single selection
sliderAt returns NaN for a stepped track whose min is -Infinity
items.note: The step grid now starts at `max`, or at 0 when both ends are infinite.

items.claim: framesSweep counts a numeric `loop` below 1 as that many passes, where the clock it reads makes at least one
sliderKey with stops and `ordered` lands a thumb between stops when the next stop is its neighbor's
sliderAt returns NaN on a track with an endless `min`, a step and no `origin`
A sweep's `at` answers NaN (or `undefined` from valuesSweep) for a NaN fraction, though documented as clamped
sliderAt returns NaN for a track whose `min` is -Infinity and that has a step but no `origin`
framesSweep counts a numeric `loop` differently from the clock it claims to mirror (loop 0, or a fraction below 1)
soloFrom and soloSweepFrom ignore `enabled` in a single selection
sliderAt under `strict` with no stops returns the raw track value, unclamped and unsnapped
